newsitem.title: USA: Late rally helps U.S. blue chips slash losses.
newsitem.headline: Late rally helps U.S. blue chips slash losses.

text.p: The Dow industrials staged a furious recovery, helped by a buy program in the closing moments of Thursday's session.

The Dow rebounded to 6432, off 17 points for the day, prompting the NYSE to lift index-arbitrage trading curbs at 1545 EST/2045 GMT. The recovery was spurred by a late buy program, which was still under way on the NYSE, according to Birinyi Associates.
The Nasdaq Composite remained sharply lower at about 1279, off 12 points.
